name: psn-robotics-quick-benchmark-v2-data
description: A compact robotics evaluation dataset intended for quick benchmarking of manipulation and control approaches. It provides task episodes, trajectories, and success/failure annotations to measure policies and imitation/control algorithms on common robotics tasks.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (binary episode success aggregated as percentage)
reputation: A small, practical dataset for quick robotics evaluation with modest community adoption for rapid prototyping and benchmarking.
